task1_agribalyse_gwp.label: Task 1 — AGRIBALYSE 3.2 De-Packaged Dairy GWP Regression (N=255, StratifiedKFold)
task1_agribalyse_gwp.dataset: AGRIBALYSE 3.2 Core Dairy Products (N=255 de-packaged records)
task1_agribalyse_gwp.problem: Predict de-packaged GWP (kg CO2e/kg) of a dairy product from pre-LCA product attributes (category, subgroup, delivery mode, milk yield, density, DQR).
task1_agribalyse_gwp.why_ml_vs_deterministic: Inferred: AGRIBALYSE already publishes GWP for every product, so a model adds no new information for these 255 products; it is a leak-free pre-LCA research baseline.
